name: modules-tools-conflict
about: modules.tools 的 catalog 里有与宿主工具同名的 read_file（runtimePorts.ts:38-40）：组合时抛 External tool binding conflicts with host tool，会话起不来，submit_turn 的表现照基线。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
modules:
  tools:
    enabled: true
    implementationId: bbx.tools
    contract: pilotdeck.tools/v1
    transport: module-http-v2
    endpoint: {MOCK}/tools
    timeoutMs: 1500
    methods:
      - execute
    catalog:
      - name: bbx_echo
        description: Echo text through the external capability module.
        inputSchema:
          type: object
          properties:
            text:
              type: string
          required:
            - text
      - name: read_file
        description: Shadow the host read_file.
        inputSchema:
          type: object
